THEWILDFIRE-HEART_OF_FIRE.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Ignite[/gold] [blue]{Ignite}[/blue].
THEWILDFIRE-HEART_OF_FIRE.flavor: Sometimes she thinks she's more fire than girl. And sometimes, she knows it.
THEWILDFIRE-HEART_OF_FIRE.title: Heart of Fire
THEWILDFIRE-HEART_OF_SORCERY.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{ConstitutionPower}[/blue] [gold]Constitution[/gold]. At the start of your turn, [gold]Ignite[/gold] [blue]{Ignite}[/blue].
THEWILDFIRE-HEART_OF_SORCERY.flavor: An ancient power dormant for generations. The barest ember, passed from mother to daughter, takes root and sets the soul ablaze.
THEWILDFIRE-HEART_OF_SORCERY.title: Heart of Sorcery
THEWILDFIRE-BOX_OF_TINDER.flavor: Something like a stress toy for a child born of flame. Shockingly, it only made things worse.
THEWILDFIRE-BOX_OF_TINDER.title: Box of Tinder
THEWILDFIRE-FIREFLOW_WRAPS.description: Whenever you [gold]Flare[/gold], reduce your [gold]Firepower[/gold] by the [gold]Flare[/gold] amount instead of setting it to [blue]0[/blue].
THEWILDFIRE-FIREFLOW_WRAPS.flavor: It's easier to keep the flame in check when you're worried about ruining your fashionable gloves.
THEWILDFIRE-FIREFLOW_WRAPS.title: Fireflow Wraps
THEWILDFIRE-ELEMENTAL_INFUSER.flavor: An esoteric device that distills the endless, gnawing burn into a fortifying warmth.
THEWILDFIRE-ELEMENTAL_INFUSER.title: Elemental Infuser
THEWILDFIRE-SPARK_GUARDS.description: At the end of your turn, [gold]Exert[/gold] [blue]{Exert}[/blue]. Gain [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Firepower[/gold] [gold]Exerted[/gold].
THEWILDFIRE-SPARK_GUARDS.flavor: Even as the flame burns, it invigorates, granting swift steps and steady endurance.
THEWILDFIRE-SPARK_GUARDS.title: Spark Guards
THEWILDFIRE-ASH_GOWN.description: Whenever you [gold]Scorch[/gold], apply 1 [gold]Heat Exhaustion[/gold] to ALL enemies.
THEWILDFIRE-ASH_GOWN.flavor: Surprisingly light and easy to move in.
THEWILDFIRE-ASH_GOWN.title: Ash Gown
THEWILDFIRE-MARTIAL_ARTISTS_BELT.flavor: [italics]"I can give you the tools to control your emotions. Using them is your responsibilty alone."[/italics]
THEWILDFIRE-MARTIAL_ARTISTS_BELT.title: Disciplined Student's Belt
THEWILDFIRE-MATCHBOOK.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{RagingFirePower}[/blue] [gold]Raging Fire[/gold].
THEWILDFIRE-MATCHBOOK.flavor: It's not like you need it to start a fire.
THEWILDFIRE-MATCHBOOK.title: Matchbook
